D/ FL IVL CRISPVS NOB CAES ; R/ PROVIDEN TIAE CAESS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Crispus (317-326), Trier mint issue of 324-326, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped right. Obverse inscription: FL IVL CRISPVS NOB CAES. Reverse description: Camp gate with two towers, star above. Reverse inscription: PROVIDEN TIAE CAESS. In exergue: STR. Diameter: 18.7mm, Weight: 3.04gms, die axis: 12
